title: Frustrating usability and support situations
summary: Reviews in this topic center on frustrating situations involving usability problems, feature operation, charging and infotainment limitations, and difficulty getting support or resolution.

negative.summary: Negative reviews describe frustration with recurring usability annoyances, weak feature performance, unusable charging guidance, slow acceleration, and poor support or unresolved problems.

mixed.summary: The mixed review combines frustration about the issue with disappointment that BMW corporate seemed not to care.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mention a situation, hood concern, or questioning a decision without enough detail to identify a clear sentiment or specific problem.

limitations: This cluster spans several different issues, including infotainment, charging, support processes, acceleration, a hood-related concern, and a hands-free trunk interaction, so it is not a single coherent defect topic.
Many fragments are very brief and describe frustration without enough context to determine the exact underlying issue.
Undetermined examples are insufficient to clarify several references to a 'situation' or decision context.
